name: SEO Warning
author: Andrew Hoyer

sections.description:
This plugin adds a warning to the WordPress admin bar when search engine visibility is off.

That’s all it does! No options, settings, or complications, just a small but obvious warning to ensure you never launch a site with the “Discourage search engines from indexing this site” box checked.

How to use

Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin repository and activate the plugin. There are no settings or options.

Developers

If you’re interested in furthering the development of the SEO Warning plugin, please find the project on GitHub:

https://github.com/andrewhoyer/wp-seo-warning/

sections.faq:
How can I help?

There are a few ways you can help make SEO Warning better and support more development:

  • Install it on WordPress sites you manage or are developing
  • Tell your friends, write a blog post, etc
  • Follow the project on GitHub, and become a Contributor
